I88 — fresh nonlinear Banach geometry and approximation discovery.

Use the pinned corpus to search for a substantial new construction or quantitative theorem around these starting families: Lipschitz-Equivalent-Separable-Banach-Spaces-Need-Not-Be-Linearly-Isomorphic-September-24-2026; Bi-Lipschitz-Absorption-of-c0-Without-a-Linear-Copy-of-c0-September-26-2026; Failure-of-Bounded-Approximation-in-a-Lipschitz-Free-Space-over-a-Uniformly-Discrete-Metric-Space-September-26-2026; Asymptotic-midpoint-uniform-convexity-and-unbounded-diamond-distortion-in-a-reflexive-tree-space-September-27-2026; Exact-asymptotic-moduli-in-a-Daugavet-subspace-of-L1-September-27-2026; Fixed-Points-of-Nonexpansive-Maps-in-Reflexive-Banach-Spaces-September-24-2026; and the doubling Hilbert subset/nonembedding and cotype-cotype companions. These are starting points, not assumed compatible conclusions. Read actual complete relevant proof operations and companions before claiming a new bridge.

Screen at least three distinct targets and develop two constructive approaches for the strongest. Promising directions to assess, rather than assume: simultaneous metric equivalence with prescribed linear invariants; quantitative approximation-complexity separation on the actual free-space construction; a new compatible geometric restriction or quantitative obstruction that cannot be obtained by merely taking direct sums, rescaling existing blocks or substituting a parameter. Distinguish AP, BAP, MAP and approximation rates; rates indexed by arbitrary rescaled blocks may be routine and must not be sold as substantial. An obstruction witnessed by finite metric subsets is not automatically global nonembeddability with the same constants. Reflexivity, separability, duality, uniform discreteness, properness, bounded geometry and doubling are separate hypotheses. Distinguish a property of the displayed norm from existence of an equivalent norm, and midpoint from full asymptotic convexity. Common fixed points of commuting maps or semigroups require their own exact invariance/compactness conditions, not a naive iteration of a one-map theorem. A continuum of labels is not a continuum of isomorphism types without a separating invariant. Never exploit an apparent contradiction among the stipulated sources or with external literature.

Read prior project screens first, particularly I12 sphere-stability/Tingley and I03/I04/I13/I28 operator/structural screens where relevant, to avoid repeating spent mechanisms. The I80 fluid candidate has just passed I85 independent original-proof review without repairs, but remains HELD pending I86 contribution review. I87 separately audits the technical close-algebra result I84. Those active lanes are not your assignment. Catalan, weighted switches, polynomial Selmer, relative packing, entropy rounding and other parked branches require new mechanisms and should not be casually reopened here. If the proposed Banach families are exhausted, broaden within functional/nonlinear geometry with explicit reasons.

Owned report frontier/iterations/i88-nonlinear-banach-discovery.md; owned dirs frontier/sources/i88_nonlinear_banach_discovery/ and frontier/experiments/i88_nonlinear_banach_discovery/.
